title: Which Royal Court Role Would You Have?
description: The castle gates open and every court needs its people. Where does your talent place you?

answers.text: Improve it with better jokes as it passes through you
Trace it to the source before reacting
Knew three days ago. Know who started it. Saying nothing.
Sketch the entire saga for the group chat

questions.text: A rumor sweeps the kingdom (your friend group). You:
Pick your seat at the grand feast:

answers.text: Head of the table. Where else?
Beside the guest who seems nervous
Back to the wall, view of both doors
Wherever the candlelight is best
Making the call no one else wants to make
Showing up first, every single day
Keeping hope alive — morale is survival
The plan that gets everyone through winter

questions.text: The kingdom faces a hard year. Your contribution:

answers.text: A training yard outside the window
Walls of books and one enormous desk
A door nobody else knows about
North-facing light and endless supplies
Directly, with the weight they deserve
Wrapped in a joke so it lands soft
With context, options, and a recommended path
Through a story that says what you can't

questions.text: How do you deliver hard truths?
Pick a royal duty you'd secretly enjoy:

answers.text: Settling disputes — you're good at verdicts
Escorting travelers safely through the mountain pass
Roasting visiting dignitaries (affectionately)
Reading everyone at the ball from the balcony
Their safety, always
Their bad days
Their secrets — all of them, forever
Their biggest feelings

questions.text: A mysterious letter arrives at court. You:

answers.text: Have it read aloud. Transparency rules here.
Read it in a dramatic voice first, contents second
Verify the seal, the ink, and the sender's motives
Already read it. Resealed it perfectly. Waiting.
A golden age with your name on it
The oath that never broke
The wisdom behind three great reigns
The works that outlived the castle itself

questions.text: Your legacy in the kingdom's history books:

answers.text: Morning training, then helping a farmer mend a fence
Testing new material on the market crowd
Catching up on correspondence, contentedly
Painting the harvest festival from the hill

questions.text: A free weekend in the kingdom. You:

answers.text: The crown. Heavy, but it fits.
The hat with the bells. Iconic.
A cloak with seventeen hidden pockets
Paint-stained sleeves, worn proudly

questions.text: Pick a piece of royal attire:

answers.text: 'The decision ends here'
'I hold the line'
'Measure twice'
'I already know'

results.description: The wisdom behind the throne. You read situations three moves deep, give counsel worth its weight in gold, and quietly steer history from a book-lined study.
The kingdom's memory and its heart. You capture what matters, say the unsayable through your work, and long after the walls fall, your art remains.
The only one allowed to tell the monarch the truth — and clever enough to make it funny. Your humor holds the court together and your wit misses nothing.
An oath in human form. Steadfast, brave, and first through every gate, you protect what matters and never need to be asked twice.
Born to carry the crown. Decisive, fair, and steady under pressure, you take responsibility others avoid — and your reign would honestly be pretty great.
The court's quiet all-seeing eye. You notice everything, reveal nothing, and know the kingdom's secrets three days before they happen. Delightfully unnerving.
